foto: Close-up of a yellow supermarket price label stuck to the glass of a deli cheese case. A finger taps a large printed number at the top, while the smaller line below is slightly out of focus. The label is bright under cool fluorescent light, with blurred cheese wheels behind the glass. No face, no other readable text.

Tight detail of the same yellow price label, now focused on the small printed line under the big number. A fingertip points to the per-kilo text. The large number above is blurred. The deli case and a row of round cheeses appear as soft shapes in the background. Cool fluorescent light, no person.

A weathered hand with age spots places a wedge of hard pale-yellow cheese onto a sheet of white deli paper on a stainless-steel scale. The cheese is unwrapped and the cut side shows small eyes. The scale display is out of frame; only the platform, paper, cheese, and hand are visible. Overhead fluorescent light.

A packaged tray of sliced cheese wrapped in clear plastic sits on a white deli counter. A small rectangular white and red price label is stuck to the plastic, slightly curled. The tray is sharp, while the curved glass of the deli case behind is blurred. No human present, cool fluorescent light from above.

A single unwrapped wedge of hard cheese rests on a folded sheet of white deli paper. The cut side is pale yellow and smooth. The background is the same deli counter, softly blurred, with the edge of a stainless scale. The wedge is the only object in focus. No person.

Two similar-looking white plastic trays of cheese sit side by side on the deli counter. They appear the same size, but one tray is full of slices and the other holds only one thin slice. The clear plastic wrap reflects the overhead lights, making the amount inside hard to judge. No person, no labels readable.

A close-up of a cheese tray label shows the small per-kilo price and net weight line. A finger points to the fine print. The tray and plastic wrap are sharp, while the background deli case is blurred. The cool fluorescent light makes the white label bright and clear. No face.

A thick wedge of semi-hard cheese with a waxy reddish-brown rind along one side sits on white deli paper. The waxy surface is cracked and clearly not food. The cut interior is pale yellow. A digital scale and curved glass deli case are blurred in the background. Cool fluorescent light, no person.

A clean center cut of the same pale-yellow cheese, with no wax rind, sits on the same white paper. The cut faces are smooth and slightly glossy. The scale and deli case remain as blurred background. The image has the same cool counter light and tight framing. No person.

A weathered hand with age spots holds a wedge of semi-hard cheese with an unusually thick dark brown rind and cracked wax coating. The wedge sits over white deli paper on a stainless counter. Next to it, a small pile of discarded rind pieces. The curved glass deli case is blurred behind; cool fluorescent light, no face.

The same weathered hand places a smaller, clean-cut wedge of pale-yellow cheese onto the white deli paper. The rind and wax have been removed, leaving only dense cheese. A few dark rind pieces rest at the edge of the frame. Same cool fluorescent counter and blurred deli case, no face.

A very close detail of a cut piece of hard cheese on white paper. Along the cut edge there are small crumbs of red paraffin wax and a thin line of hard dark rind. The contrast between wax, rind, and pale interior is extremely sharp. The background is completely blurred. No person.

The same cut edge of hard cheese after the paraffin crumbs and hard rind have been peeled away. The edge is clean and smooth, pale yellow. The white paper below is empty except for the cheese. The same macro framing and cool light. No person.

A digital deli scale shows a small positive reading on its red display while a sheet of white paper rests on the platform. The reading is just above zero. A hand hovers near the tare button. The background shows the blurred curved glass of the cheese case. Cool fluorescent light.

The same digital deli scale with white paper on the platform now shows zero on the red display. A gloved finger points to the zero. The hand and scale are sharp, the cheese case behind is completely blurred. Cool fluorescent light, no person.

A hand places a fresh sheet of crisp white deli paper onto the clean platform of a digital scale. The paper is flat and square. The scale display shows zero but is slightly blurred. The curved glass of the cheese case glows softly in the background. No person, cool light.

A weathered finger presses the tare button on the side of the digital scale. The white paper remains on the platform. The red display is blurred but suggests zero. The hand has visible wrinkles and no jewelry. The deli case and steel counter are soft behind. No face.

A wedge of pale-yellow cheese sits on the white paper on the scale. The digital display shows a weight in red, slightly out of focus. The cheese is unwrapped and the cut side faces the camera. The stainless-steel counter is clean, and the deli case is blurred. No person.

A digital scale display shows the number 310 in bright red while several slices of cheese lie on white paper on the platform. A hand holds one extra slice above the pile, about to add it. The deli counter is cool and fluorescent, with the cheese case blurred behind.

A deli worker's hand offers one extra slice of cheese on the tip of a knife toward the camera. The background shows a scale with a pile of slices and white paper. The worker's face is not visible, only the dark green apron and the hand. Cool fluorescent light.

A digital scale shows 250 grams in red digits. A neat stack of three cheese slices rests on white paper. A hand is placed flat on the counter beside the scale. No extra slices, no knife in motion. The deli case is soft in the background. Cool light.

A digital scale display shows 310 grams while a pile of four cheese slices sits on white paper. A hand is about to add another slice. The scene is bright under fluorescent lights, with the cheese case blurred behind. No face.

The same digital scale now shows 250 grams. The pile has been reduced to two or three slices on the same white paper. A hand rests near the scale; no one is holding a knife. The background is the same blurred deli case and steel counter.

A close-up of a printed deli label on a cheese package. The line with the per-kilo price is highlighted by a fingertip. The label is white with black and red printed lines, slightly curled on the plastic wrap. The cheese case is blurred behind. No face.

A digital deli scale displays the net weight in large red digits. A white paper and a cheese wedge sit on the platform. The display is sharp and the rest blurred. No person visible, only the scale and cheese. Cool fluorescent light.

A supermarket receipt lies on a white counter. The total line is visible but only as a printed number, not readable. A hand holds the receipt flat. The background is the deli case, softly blurred. Cool fluorescent light from above. No face.
